description: This file defines an APIService class for handling HTTP requests using axios, including methods for CRUD operations, request configuration, response interceptors, caching, and error handling within a Vue.js application.

classes.name: APIService
classes.description: A class providing methods to perform HTTP requests with axios, manage response interceptors, handle errors, and implement caching strategies.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the APIService with base URL and API section, sets up axios instance and response interceptors.

methods.name: setIgnorePath
methods.description: Sets a regex pattern to ignore certain error paths from showing error messages.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Performs a GET request to retrieve all resources, with optional query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to retrieve a specific resource by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Performs a POST request to create a new resource with provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to update a resource by ID with provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to remove a resource by ID.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to remove multiple resources, optionally with data.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs a custom HTTP request with specified options.

methods.name: ignoreError
methods.description: Determines whether to ignore certain errors based on regex pattern and status codes.

methods.name: setupResponseInterceptors
methods.description: Configures axios response and request interceptors for error handling, caching, and token refresh logic.
